### The Faithfulness of God When We Are Unfaithful
Author: Laura Bailey
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/the-faithfulness-of-god-when-we-are-unfaithful-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Genesis 12:20
Points:
- Abram followed God into Canaan, but severe drought prompted him to seek relief in Egypt.
- Motivated by fear instead of faith, he concealed his marriage to Sarai to protect himself.
- God sent plagues on Pharaoh's household, uncovering the lie and prompting Pharaoh to send Abram away.
- Abram's failure to trust God did not derail the Lord's overarching redemptive plan.
- Human unfaithfulness and poor choices cannot thwart God's sovereign purposes and enduring grace.

### When We Fall Short
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-daily-devotion-november-9.html
Passage: Genesis 12:10
Points:
- Even Abram, a model of biblical faith, experienced a serious lapse of trust during a famine.
- Instead of calling upon God in prayer, Abram took matters into his own hands and fled to Egypt.
- Fear led Abram to compromise his integrity and involve his wife in a deceptive scheme.
- The deception was inevitably uncovered, bringing Abram a stinging rebuke from an unbelieving ruler.
- Believers inevitably fall short and face exposure, but God readily offers forgiveness when we confess our sin.
